Lena (Sales): Starting Crescent Analytics POC thread. Olga from Crescent joining. Use case: hybrid semantic search + short-form generation for support KB. Need to lock success criteria, pricing expectations, and security constraints. Can we do a 45m kickoff tomorrow?
Jonah (Solutions): I can. Draft agenda: 1) Use-case walkthrough 2) Data shape & volumes 3) Eval plan & pass/fail 4) Deployment option (hosted/dedicated/private) 5) Security checklist + timelines 6) Next steps.
Rina (Eng): For planning, please confirm corpus size, average doc tokens, and expected concurrent queries. Also whether they expect multi-lingual support.
Olga (Customer): Corpus ~45k docs, avg ~220 tokens, bilingual (EN/ES). Pilot QPS ~6 steady, bursts to 20. Need p95 < 700ms for search+snippet. Prefer reranking for top-5 results.
Marco (SRE): Given bursts to 20 QPS hosted likely ok for pilot with autoscaling; dedicated makes sense if sustained. Also need to know if logs/data must remain in EU.
Jonah (Solutions): Key POC scoping items: - Eval set: 150 prompts per language (total 300) with golden answers - Metrics: recall@5, MRR, and human pass rate - Cost guardrail: target blended cost/query <= $0.20 - Security: encryption at rest/in transit, VPC peering option, SIEM integration.
Rina (Eng): Re: embeddings vs full-gen: plan for dense retrieval (embeddings) + reranker + short-gen for snippets. That should keep token costs moderate. We'll need to know average context window for generation (we budget 300 tokens).
Olga (Customer): That works. Priority is precision in Spanish answers, so eval needs Spanish-focused prompts. Also redaction for PII is required.
sec-bot: Crescent security questionnaire: https://redwood.internal/sec-forms/crescent-poc 535 fill data flow and encryption pages by EOD.
Lena (Sales): Pricing note: Crescent prefers predictable billing. We'll propose pilot on hosted with a fixed monthly cap and option to reserve Dedicated after pilot.
Marco (SRE): Ops checklist for POC onboarding: - Service account + scoped API key - Network setup (VPC peering or private link) - Expected traffic pattern (sustained vs spikes) - Observability hooks (per-request token counts, latency, model version) - Runbook + oncall contacts.
Jonah (Solutions): Proposed success criteria: 1) recall@5 >= 0.75 on combined eval set 2) MRR >= 0.5 3) human pass rate >= 80% on sampled 100 responses 4) infra: p95 <=700ms 5) security: VPC + audit logs enabled. Acceptable?
Olga (Customer): recall@5 0.75 OK, need higher Spanish pass rate but pilot ok with these targets. Confirmed VPC preferred and EU data residency required.
Rina (Eng): Action items: I'll share an eval harness and CSV template for bilingual prompts (by EOD). We can also provide a small labeling budget if Crescent needs help creating golden answers.
Jonah (Solutions): I'll sketch cost scenarios: hosted with monthly cap, hosted pay-as-you-go, and 3-month dedicated reserved pricing. Bring cost per query estimates for both embedding + rerank and embedding+rerank+snippet.
Marco (SRE): Please provide network contact for Crescent to kick off peering. Also confirm retention window for logs (default 90 days, can be reduced).
Olga (Customer): I'll send infra contact and legal/security lead. Log retention must be <=45 days and sensitive fields redacted.
Lena (Sales): Meeting scheduled: tomorrow 09:30am PT. Invite includes Crescent infra and security. Prep: Crescent to share sample Spanish/English prompts and infra contact; Redwood to bring eval harness, cost sketches, and minimal runbook.
Jonah (Solutions): Sample prompt CSV we expect: id, lang, context_doc_id, question, expected_answer, priority. Example row in harness.
Rina (Eng): Example CSV row we will include: ```csv
id,lang,context_doc_id,question,expected_answer,priority
1,es,doc_445,"1?Cf3mo resto mi suscripcif3n?","El cliente puede cancelar desde la cuenta en 14 dedas",high```
Lena (Sales): Good. Let's keep thread for updates. If anyone sees a blocker ping me directly. :rocket:
